title: Shard manifest (shard.yaml)
description: The top-level manifest for a ShardMind shard. Lives at the root of the shard repository and declares identity, versioning, hooks, and dependencies. Validated on every install/update.

apiVersion.description: Schema version of shard.yaml. v1 is the only accepted value in v0.x.

name.description: Package name within its namespace. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only. Example: "obsidian-mind".

namespace.description: Owner namespace. Typically your GitHub username or organization. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of the shard. Shown in the install wizard.

persona.description: Who this shard is for. Displayed in the install header (e.g., "AI-augmented research vaults").

homepage.description: URL to the shard's project page or documentation.

requires.description: Environment requirements. `obsidian` / `node` are advisory in v0.1; `shardmind` is engine-enforced before any vault write (install/update/adopt).

obsidian.description: Minimum Obsidian version required (semver range). Advisory only.

node.description: Minimum Node.js version required for hook execution (semver range). Advisory only.

shardmind.description: Semver range the running ShardMind engine must satisfy. Enforced: install/update/adopt refuse with SHARDMIND_VERSION_MISMATCH when unmet. Absent means no check.

dependencies.description: Other shards this shard needs installed alongside it. Validated, not fetched: the shard's user installs them; fetching on install is planned (#82). Defined in 1.0 (#369).

name.description: The dependency shard's name: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

namespace.description: The dependency shard's namespace: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

version.description: A semver range the dependency's version must satisfy, e.g. "^1.0.0".

migrations.description: Path renames between releases (#178). `shardmind update` carries a user's edits from each old path to its new one. See docs/AUTHORING.md §3 and docs/SHARD-LAYOUT.md §Rename migrations.

from.description: Semver of the release before the rename.

to.description: Semver of the release that makes the rename; greater than `from`.

renames.description: Old vault path → new vault path. Relative, POSIX, inside the vault, not under .shardmind/.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hook file paths (relative to the shard root). See docs/AUTHORING.md §6.

bootstrap.description: Unmanaged-path setup (git init, indexes). Runs on install/adopt, and on update when its fingerprint changes. A bare path string, or an object with the script path and an optional opaque fingerprint string.

script.description: Path to the bootstrap TypeScript file.

fingerprint.description: Opaque version token; bumping it re-runs bootstrap on update (compared with !==, not hashed).

personalize.description: Managed-file edits. Runs on install/adopt only; the engine skips it entirely when the user accepted all default values (Invariant 2).

post-update.description: Additive managed-file edits over ctx.newFiles. Runs after `shardmind update` (Invariant 3).

post-install.description: REMOVED in 1.0 (HOOK_SLOT_REMOVED): a shard.yaml that declares it fails to load. Move unmanaged setup to `bootstrap` (always runs) and managed-file edits to `personalize` (runs only on non-default values). Worked split: https://github.com/breferrari/shardmind/blob/main/docs/AUTHORING.md#post-install-was-removed-in-10

timeout_ms.description: Per-slot hook execution timeout in milliseconds. Default 30000; valid range 1000–600000.
